subject: Vendor activation & invoice ladder — early pay pathway request
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@procureco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureCo Finance <ap@procureco.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding / payment terms question for Redwood

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the team is excited to move forward. We're completing our vendor onboarding checklist and have two items to confirm before we submit the paperwork:

1) Payment terms — our standard policy is Net 45. Is Redwood able to accept Net 45 for the first 12 months while we complete the internal PO cadence?
2) Early pay option — we sometimes enroll in early-pay programs (1.25% discount for payment within 10 days). Would Redwood consider an early-pay discount program or a dynamic discount once PO/GL mapping is confirmed?

We can attach the W-9 and our vendor setup form now if that helps accelerate account creation.

Attachments: ProcureCo_W9.pdf (stub), vendor_setup_form.pdf (stub)

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Finance Manager — Vendor Ops
ProcureCo Inc.
elena.ruiz@procureco.com
(415) 555-0192
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@procureco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding / payment terms question for Redwood

Hi Elena — great to hear.

Short answers up front: we can onboard with Net 45 as exceptional terms, but that requires finance approval and a slightly different PO activation workflow. Redwood's default is Net 30. We do offer early-pay enrollment at a negotiated discount (pointer: Finance Ops handles the %).

To move quickly, could you:
- Confirm the billing entity (legal name and remit address) and invoice sample (if you have a billing contact different from AP).
- Complete & return the vendor_setup_form.pdf (attached) and W-9 (already attached).

Looping in Marissa (Finance Ops) and Ben (AE) to surface any approvals or standard playbooks — Marissa, Ben: ProcureCo prefers Net 45 + potential 1.25% early-pay for 10-day pay. Can Finance approve Net 45 for the first year provided the PO is issued on time and ProcureCo enrolls in our PO/Invoice routing template? If not, what's the standard counter (Net 30 with 1.5% early-pay for 15 days perhaps)? Happy to align contract language / add a clause for a 12-month temp term.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Strategic Accounts Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding — Net 45 / early-pay (ProcureCo)

Kim / Ben,

Thanks for the context. Finance Ops notes:
- Net 45 is not our standard, but we will consider a time-limited Net 45 (12 months) if ProcureCo signs the PO activation SLA and uses our PO_Template.xlsx for invoice lines (helps with GL mapping).
- Early-pay program: we typically offer 1.5% discount for payment within 15 days (our standard dynamic discount slab). We can make an exception to 1.25% for 10 days if the vendor is strategic, but we should reserve that for larger ARR.

Operational steps to enable Net 45 temporary approval:
1) Vendor returns completed vendor_setup_form.pdf + W-9 (already provided).
2) Finance receives sample invoice mapped to PO_Template.xlsx (see attached).
3) Legal signs a short amendment: "Temporary Net 45 pilot for 12 months; subject to timely PO issuance and invoice routing compliance."
4) AR config: mailbox routing and early-pay enrollment form (we'll send DocuSign link).

Ben, can you confirm ProcureCo's expected ARR and whether this is a single-SKU purchase or multi-quarter contract? That will inform discount flexibility.

I'll prepare the DocuSign packet for the temporary terms and the early-pay enrollment form once we have the sample invoice.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@procureco.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding / payment terms question for Redwood

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the W-9 and vendor form.

We can proceed with the following path:
- Temporary Net 45 for the first 12 months, contingent on: timely PO issuance consistent with the PO_Template.xlsx, and submission of at least one sample invoice that follows our invoice line-item mapping.
- Early-pay program: ProcureCo can enroll at a 1.5% discount for payments made within 15 days (standard). We are willing to offer 1.25% for 10-day pay for this pilot if ProcureCo confirms ARR > $150k for the first year. Please confirm ARR expectation in your reply.

Next steps for ProcureCo (action items):
1) Reply with billing entity / remit-to address and a sample invoice in ProcureCo's current format.
2) Confirm expected ARR / contract size (ballpark is fine).
3) Sign the DocuSign packet we will send (temporary terms + early-pay enrollment). DocuSign link will arrive from RedwoodAR@redwood.com.

Attached: PO_Template.xlsx (stub)

Once we receive the sample invoice and the signed packet, we will create your vendor record and enable the PO lane. Expect AP onboarding to complete within 5 business days of receipt.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
